title: Similar: Stop-and-Go Traffic Jam Assist Simulation
goal: Build a stop-and-go traffic jam assist simulation that cruises at a capped highway speed when the lane is clear, follows a lead vehicle through repeated slowdowns to full stops, and restarts smoothly while meeting gap, comfort, and settling targets from radar CSV data and YAML vehicle settings.
skillBenefitRationale: Keeps the original longitudinal automotive control structure while shifting to stop-and-go behavior, so the agent still has to load YAML parameters, process time-series CSV sensor data, tune PID loops, simulate vehicle-gap dynamics, and compute control-performance metrics from the run outputs.
